run_lanczos_alg: run the Lanczos algorithm to tridiagonalize a real symmetric matrix with full reorthogonalization
build_max_eigenvector_lanczos: build the max eigenvector of a symmetric matrix using Lanczos iteration and scipy eigendecomposition
build_min_eigenvector_lanczos: build the min eigenvector of a symmetric matrix by finding the max eigenvector of its negation
build_max_eigenvector_exact: build the max eigenvector of a symmetric matrix via exact scipy eigendecomposition
test_safe_eigh: test the safe eigendecomposition function that handles zero-norm matrices gracefully
